※ 얇게 썰은 양배추 세포벽이 파과되면서 설포라판 흡수율이 5배 올라가는데 거기에 씨겨자 설포라판 흡수율을 최대치로 높여줘서 맛있고 건강하게 드실 수 있어요!

#양배추샐러드 #드레싱 #요거트드레싱
-재료
양배추 400g, 당근 1/3개, 식초 2스푼, 식초 1스푼, 소금 반티스푼 
씨겨자 1티스푼, 꿀 1스푼, 레몬즙 1스푼, 그릭요거트 4스푼, 후춧가루 약간

-레시피
1. 양배추를 채칼로 얇게 쳐주세요.
2. 양배추를 씻어서 물을 잠길정도로 넣고 식초 2스푼 넣고 5분 담가주세요.
3. 당근도 채 썰어주세요.
4. 양배추를 씻어주세요.
5. 양배추, 당근을 식초 1스푼, 소금 반티스푼 넣고 15분 절여주세요.
6. 양배추 건져서 물기를 꼭 짜주세요.
7. 양배추에 씨겨자 1티스푼, 꿀 1스푼, 레몬즙 1스푼, 그릭요거트 4스푼, 후춧가루 약간  넣고 섞어주세요.

#마늘쫑볶음 #소고기 #다짐육
-재료
소고기 다짐육 300g, 마늘쫑 300g, 청양고추 5개, 올리브유 2스푼
다진마늘 1스푼, 진간장 2스푼, 자일로스설탕 1티스푼, 생강청 1티스푼
소금 3g, 조청 크게 1스푼, 굴소스 반스푼,  참기름 1스푼, 맛술 1스푼
후춧가루 약간,  깨 1스푼

-레시피
1. 마늘쫑을 잘게 썰어주세요.
2. 청양고추 칼집을 넣어서 다져주세요.
3. 팬에 소고기다짐육을 넣고 올리브유 2스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼 넣어서 볶아주세요.
4. 고기가 어느정도 익으면 진간장 2스푼, 자일로스설탕 1티스푼, 생강청 1티스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
5. 마늘쫑, 고추를 넣어주세요.
6. 소금 3g 넣고 볶아주세요.
7. 조청 크게 1스푼 넣어주세요.
8. 마지막에 굴소스 반스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
9. 참기름 1스푼, 맛술 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
10. 마지막에 후춧가루 약간,  깨 1스푼 뿌려주세요.

snippet.title: " 대파닭구이 집에 있는 000소스만 준비하세요. 끝내주는 맛 비결 이거입니다. "
snippet.description:
#닭구이 #닭다리살구이 #닭조림

-재료
닭다리살 700g, 천일염 1스푼, 밀가루 1스푼, 대파 3대, 소금 3꼬집
맛술 2스푼 , 마늘한줌, 돈가스소스 2스푼, 굴소스 반스푼, 후춧가루

-레시피
1. 닭다리살 700g, 천일염 1스푼, 밀가루 1스푼, 물 약간 넣고 주물러주세요.
2. 닭을 깨끗하게 물에 헹궈주세요.
3. 대파를 4cm 간격으로 썰어주세요.
4. 닭다리살 물기를 키친타올로 제거해주세요.
5. 두꺼운 닭다리살은 칼집을 넣어서 소금 3꼬집으로 밑간을 해주세요.
6. 팬에 닭다리살 껍질부분이 밑으로 가게 두고 맛술 2스푼 넣고 구워주세요.
7. 눌러가면서 노릇노릇하게 구워서 썰어주세요.
8. 대파, 마늘한줌 넣고 구워주세요.
9. 돈가스소스 2스푼, 굴소스 반스푼 넣고 약불로 줄여서 섞어주세요.
10. 마지막에 불 끄고 후춧가루를 넣어주세요.

snippet.title: 🔴 담아서 바로 먹어도 기가막힌 밥도둑 “깻잎김치” 뚝딱 생방송
snippet.description:
#깻잎김치 #깻잎 #반찬 
-재료
깻잎 10묶음( 110장), 부추 140g, 홍고추 4개,  양파 반개(120g)
진간장 3스푼, 국간장 3스푼, 까나리액젓 2스푼, 매실액 3스푼, 올리고당 2스푼
다진마늘 1스푼, 생강청 반티스푼, 고춧가루 5스푼, 물 5스푼, 깨 2스푼

-레시피
1.깻잎을 식초물에 5분 담가두었다가 씻어주세요.
2. 깻잎 꼭지를 1cm정도 남겨두고 썰어주세요.
3. 양파를 채 썰어주세요.
4. 부추를 2cm에서 3cm 간격으로 썰어주세요. 
5. 홍고추 반갈라서 씨 태자를 빼고 얇게 썰어주세요.
6. 채소에 진간장 3스푼, 국간장 3스푼, 까나리액젓 2스푼, 매실액 3스푼, 올리고당 2스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼, 생강청 반티스푼, 고춧가루 5스푼, 물 5스푼, 깨 2스푼 섞어 양념을 만들어주세요.
7. 깻잎 3장씩 겹쳐서 양념을 발라주세요.

snippet.title: " 브로콜리 이렇게 드시면 매일 드십니다 " 매일 먹어도 질리지 않는 맛!
snippet.description:
#브로콜리샐러드 #브로콜리무침 #요거트드레싱
-재료
브로콜리 1개, 식초 1스푼, 물 1.5리터, 밀가루 1스푼, 견과류
물 50ml, 삶은계란 3개, 들깨가루 3스푼, 아카시아꿀 20g
그릭요거트 3스푼, 진간장 1티스푼, 들기름 1티스푼, 통들깨 1스푼

-레시피
1. 물에 식초 1스푼 풀어서 집게로 브로콜리 줄기를 잡아서 5분 담가두세요.
2. 브로콜리를 씻어서 먹기 좋은 크기로 잘라주세요.
3. 물 1.5리터에 밀가루 1스푼 풀어서 브로콜리를 10분 담가두었다가 씻어주세요.
4. 브로콜리를 물 50ml 넣어서 전자렌지에 3분 익혀주세요.
5. 브로콜리를 건져두세요.
6. 삶은계란을 썰어주세요.
7. 들깨가루 3스푼, 아카시아꿀 20g, 그릭요거트 3스푼, 진간장 1티스푼, 들기름 1티스푼, 통들깨 1스푼 섞어주세요.
8. 브로콜리 넣고 섞어주세요.
9. 계란을 넣고 섞어주세요.
10. 견과류도 올려주세요.

snippet.title: 🔴무조건 맛있는 기가 막힌맛 엄마표 “돼지고기 김치찌개 ” 뚝딱 생방송
snippet.description:
#돼지김치찌개 #김치찌개 #돼지찌개 
-재료
두부 300g, 돼지고기 찌개용 전지살 300g, 김치 1/4쪽, 대파 1대, 양파 100g
청양고추 2개, 김치국물 100ml, 파우더 사골육수 2개, 쌀뜨물 500ml
새우젓 1스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼, 다진생강 반티스푼, 식용유 2스푼
고춧가루 2스푼, 참치액 1스푼

-레시피
1. 대파를 어슷 썰어주세요.
2. 청양고추를 썰어주세요.
3. 양파를 큼직하게 썰어주세요.
4. 두부도 큼직하게 썰어주세요.
5. 팬에 식용유를 2스푼정도 두르고 돼지고기를 먼저 볶아주세요.
6. 새우젓 1스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼, 다진생강 반티스푼, 양파 넣고 볶아주세요.
7. 고춧가루 1스푼 넣고 중불로 줄여서 볶아주세요.
8. 김치를 썰어서 넣어 볶아주세요.
9. 파우더 사골육수 2개, 김치국물 100ml 넣고 볶아주세요.
10. 쌀뜨물 500ml 넣고 끓여주세요.
11. 대파 줄기부분만 먼저 넣고 10분 끓여주세요.
12. 남은 대파, 고추, 두부를 넣고 끓여주세요.
13. 간을 보고 부족한 간을 맞춰주세요.
      저는 참치액 1스푼, 고춧가루 1스푼 더 넣고 끓여줄게요.
14. 총 15분정도 끓여주시면 완성

snippet.title: " 상추 왕창 넣고 만든 물김치는 익힐 필요 없어요. 바로 드시면 끝내주는 물김치  "
snippet.description:
#상추물김치 #상추 #물김치
-재료
상추, 물 3.5리터, 천일염 3스푼, 쪽파 300g, 고춧가루 4스푼
양파 350g, 홍고추 200g, 사과 200g, 멸치액젓 8스푼, 물 3리터
새우젓 2스푼, 다진생강 반스푼, 통마늘 10개, 밀가루 2스푼
매실액 4스푼, 고운소금 5g( 1티스푼), 홍고추 2개(데코용)

-레시피
1. 물 3.5리터 천일염 3스푼 풀어주세요.
2. 상추를 소금물에 20분 절여주세요.
3. 쪽파를 썰어주세요.
4. 양파 350g 반은 채 썰고 반은 갈때 사용하게 썰어주세요.
5. 믹서기에 양파, 홍고추 200g, 사과 200g, 멸치액젓 6스푼, 새우젓 2스푼, 다진생강 반스푼, 통마늘 10개, 물 300ml 넣고 갈아주세요.
6. 고춧가루 4스푼도 같이 넣어서 갈아주세요.
7. 물 100ml에 밀가루 2스푼 풀어주세요.
8. 끓는물 400ml에 밀가루물을 부어서 풀을 쒀주세요.
9. 절인 상추를 건져주세요.
10. 물 2.2리터에 채반을 이용해서 갈은 양념을 풀어 건더기는 걸러주세요.
11. 풀물을 부어주세요.

9. 버섯은 건져내고 간장을 부어주세요.
10. 접시로 눌러서 뚜껑 닫아주세요.
( 하루 뒤에 한번 위아래로 바꿔주세요. )
11. 2일 후에 드세요. 김치냉장고 보관하고 드시면 됩니다.

snippet.title: 아침식사로 가볍게 이거 어떠세요? " 밥 없이도 맛있는 계란오믈렛 "
snippet.description:
#토마토오믈렛 #오믈렛 #계란오믈렛
-재료
쪽파 32g, 파프리카 25g, 토마토 120g, 계란 3개, 소금 4꼬집
다진마늘 1티스푼, 모차렐라치즈 한줌

-레시피
1. 쪽파 32g, 파프리카 25g, 토마토 120g 다져주세요.
2. 계란 3개, 소금 2꼬집 풀어주세요. 
3. 팬에 식용유를 두르고 다진마늘 1티스푼 , 쪽파 2스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
4. 토마토, 파프리카, 소금 2꼬집 넣고 볶아주세요.
5. 볶은걸 덜어 놓고 팬을 닦아서 기름을 다시 둘러주세요.
6. 계란을 붓고 남은 쪽파를 골고루 뿌려주세요.
7. 한쪽에 볶은 토마토를 올려주세요.
8. 토마토 위에 모차렐라치즈 한줌 올려주세요.
9. 계란이 익으면 반으로 접어서 뚜껑을 엎어 치즈를 녹여주세요.
10. 토치 있으면 치즈에 토치를 해주세요.

snippet.title: 🔴 “냉장고 일주일 두어도 물이 안나오는 가지볶음! ” 뚝딱 생방송
snippet.description:
#가지반찬 #가지요리 #가지볶음
-재료
가지 3개, 소금 1티스푼, 물엿 2스푼, 꽈리고추 100g
멸치 40g, 소금 2꼬집, 올리브유 3스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼
진간장 2스푼, 미림 1스푼, 물엿 1스푼, 고춧가루 1스푼
참기름 1스푼, 깨 1스푼 

-레시피
1. 가지를 먹기 좋은 크기로 썰어주세요.
2. 가지에 소금 1티스푼, 물엿 2스푼 넣고 절여주세요.
3. 꽈리고추에 포크로 구멍을 찔러주세요.
4. 팬에 멸치를 기름없이 볶아주세요.
5. 10분정도 절인 가지를 물기없이 짜주세요.
6. 팬에 올리브유 3스푼 두르고 꽈리고추,  소금 2꼬집 넣고 볶아주세요. 
7. 다진마늘 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
8. 가지를 넣고 볶아주세요.
9. 진간장 2스푼, 미림 1스푼, 물엿 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
10. 볶아지면 고춧가루 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
11. 다 볶아지면 불 끄고 참기름 1스푼, 깨 1스푼 넣고 섞어주세요.

snippet.title: 두릅 초장 찍먹 그만!! " 두릅 이렇게 드시면 처음 드시는 분들도 다 좋아하세요 "
snippet.description:
#두릅전#두릅 #두릅요리

-재료
두릅 150g, 물 1리터, 천일염 반스푼, 계란 3개, 소금 2g
참기름 1티스푼, 부침가루 2스푼, 식용유 

-레시피
1. 끓는 물 1리터에 천일염 반스푼 넣어주세요.
2. 두릅을 뿌리부분부터 먼저 넣고 10초뒤에 전부 다 넣어서 30초 더 데쳐주세요.
3. 두릅을 찬물에 헹궈주세요
4. 계란 3개, 소금 2g, 참기름 1티스푼 넣고 풀어주세요.
5. 두릅에 부침가루 2스푼으로 골고루 묻혀주세요.
6. 팬에 식용유를 넉넉하게 둘러주세요.
7. 두릅을 계란을 묻혀서 구워주세요.

snippet.title: "시원 깔끔한 열무물김치 맛 비결 ? " 찹쌀풀 대신 이거죠!
snippet.description:
#열무물김치 #열무김치 
-재료
열무 900g, 얼갈이 1.5kg, 물 3리터, 천일염 400ml, 감자 300g, 물 100ml
물 4리터, 쪽파 200g, 홍고추 5개, 양파 2개(200g), 사과 1개
새우젓 2스푼, 멸치액젓 100ml, 매실액 4스푼, 고춧가루 200ml 
천일염 1스푼, 다진생강 1스푼, 다진마늘 3스푼


-레시피
1. 얼갈이 뿌리를 잘라내고 속을 털고 긴거는 반으로 잘라주세요.
2. 열무는 겉잎 떼어내고 잎부분은 일부만 놔두고 잘라서 손질해주세요.
3. 물 3리터에 천일염 200ml 풀어주세요.
4. 열무 얼갈이를 소금물에 적셔서 천일염 200ml로 나눠서 뿌려주면서 절여주세요.
5. 감자 300g 썰어서 물 100ml 넣고 전자렌지에 익혀주세요.
6. 쪽파를 뿌리쪽은 다지고 줄기는 3cm 정도 길이로 썰어주세요.
7. 홍고추 칼집 넣어서 다져주세요.
8. 양파 1개 반은 채 썰고 반은 갈때 사용할게요.
9. 믹서기에 양파 반개, 사과 1개, 익은감자, 새우젓 2스푼, 멸치액젓 100ml, 매실액 4스푼 넣고 갈아주세요.
10.  4리터 물에 (물은 여기서 350ml만 미리 빼두세요) 갈은 재료를 채반에 걸러서 넣어주세요.
11. 빼 둔 350ml 물에 고춧가루 200ml 풀어 불려두세요.
12. 채반에 천일염 1스푼 넣고 양념물에 풀어주세요.
13. 20분 불린 고춧가루물도 채반에 부어서 걸러서 넣어주세요.
14. 썰어 넣은 재료를 국물에 넣어주세요.
14. 다진생강 1스푼, 다진마늘 3스푼 넣어주세요.
15. 절인 열무, 얼갈이에 물을 부어서 건져주세요. (절이는 중간에 한번 뒤집어주세요)
16. 김치통에 열무 얼갈이를 담으면서 국물도 중간중간 부어주세요.
17. 상온에 하루정도 익혀주세요.

snippet.title: 🔴 아삭아삭 시원한 맛에 놀라는 청경채김치 뚝딱 생방송
snippet.description:
#청경채김치 #청경채 #김치
-재료
손질 후 청경채 3.5kg, 물 2.5리터, 천일염 300ml, 물 200ml, 밀가루 1스푼
쪽파 200g, 건고추 50g(불려주세요), 홍고추 100g, 고춧가루 200ml 
양파 100g, 무 100g, 배 200g, 사과 200g, 멸치액젓 100ml, 새우젓 3스푼 
다진마늘 3스푼, 생강청 1티스푼, 매실액 4스푼

-레시피
1, 청경채를 씻어서 반으로 잘라서 큰거는 칼집을 넣어주세요.
2. 물 2.5리터에 천일염 200ml 풀어주세요.
3. 청경채를 소금물에 적셔서 천일염 100ml로 골고루 뿌려서 절여주세요.
4. 물 200ml에 밀가루 1스푼 풀어서 풀물을 쒀주세요.
5. 쪽파를 썰어주세요.
6. 믹서기에 양파 100g, 무 100g, 배 200g, 사과 200g, 멸치액젓 100ml, 새우젓 3스푼 넣고 갈아주세요.
7. 불린 건고추, 홍고추, 물 150ml 넣고 갈아주세요.
8. 갈은 양념을 붓고 믹서기에 물 50ml 넣고 헹궈서 넣으세요.
9. 풀도 넣어주세요.
10. 고춧가루 200ml 넣어주세요.
11. 다진마늘 3스푼, 생강청 1티스푼 섞어주세요.
12. 매실액 4스푼 섞어주세요.
13. 40분 절이고 물을 부어서 건져서 짜주세요. (절이는 중간에 한번 뒤집어주세요)
14. 물기를 30분 빼주세요.
15. 양념에 쪽파도 섞어주세요.
16. 물기 뺀 청경채를 양념에 버무려주세요.

snippet.title: " 밀가루 없이 가지전이 바삭!!! " 가지의 계절 이렇게 드셔보세요.
snippet.description:
#가지전 #가지요리 #전

-재료
가지 3개, 라이스페이퍼, 물 120ml, 소금 6g
당근, 쪽파 3줄기, 청양고추 2개, 계란 2개

-레시피
1. 가지를 납작하게 썰어주세요.
2. 물 120ml에 소금 5g 녹여서 가지를 절여주세요.
3. 당근을 채 썰어서 가지랑 같이 절여주세요.
4. 쪽파 3줄기, 청양고추 2개 다져주세요.
5. 계란 2개 , 소금 1g, 쪽파, 청양고추 넣고 섞어주세요.
6. 가지를 건져서 물기를 꽉 짜주세요.
7. 가지에 계란을 섞어주세요.
8. 팬에 식용유를 두르고 라이스페이퍼 올리가 가지를 펼쳐서 라이스페이퍼로 덮어서 구워주세요.
9. 가지가 다익으면 라이스페이퍼를 앞, 뒤로 한장씩 더 올려서 구워주면 더 바삭하고 맛있어요,

5. 토마토도 다져주세요.

en-US.title: "A super simple dressing that boosts cabbage's anti-cancer components 10 times and lets you easil...
en-US.description:
※ As the cell walls of thinly sliced ​​cabbage break down, the absorption rate of sulforaphane increases fivefold. Since Dijon mustard further maximizes this absorption rate, you can enjoy a delicious and healthy meal!

#CabbageSalad #Dressing #YogurtDressing

-Ingredients

400g cabbage, 1/3 carrot, 2 tablespoons vinegar, 1 tablespoon vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 4 tablespoons Greek yogurt, a pinch of black pepper

-Recipe

1. Slice the cabbage thinly using a vegetable slicer.

2. Wash the cabbage, add enough water to cover it, add 2 tablespoons of vinegar, and soak for 5 minutes.

3. Julienne the carrot as well.

4. Wash the cabbage.

5. Marinate the cabbage and carrot with 1 tablespoon of vinegar and 1/2 teaspoon of salt for 15 minutes. 6. Drain the cabbage and squeeze out the excess water.

7. Add 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard, 1 tablespoon of honey, 1 tablespoon of lemon juice, 4 tablespoons of Greek yogurt, and a pinch of black pepper to the cabbage and mix.

#StirFriedGarlicScapes #Beef #GroundMeat

-Ingredients

300g ground beef, 300g garlic scapes, 5 Cheongyang chili peppers, 2 tablespoons olive oil

1 tablespoon minced garlic, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 teaspoon xylitol sugar, 1 teaspoon ginger syrup

3g salt, 1 large tablespoon rice syrup, 1/2 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, cooking wine 1 tablespoon

A pinch of black pepper, 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds

- Recipe

1. Finely chop the garlic scapes.

2. Score the Cheongyang chili peppers and mince them.

3. Put the ground beef in a pan, add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of minced garlic, and stir-fry.

4. Once the meat is cooked to some extent, add 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of xylitol sugar, and 1 teaspoon of ginger syrup, and stir-fry.

5. Add the garlic scapes and chili peppers.

6. Add 3g of salt and stir-fry.

7. Add 1 large tablespoon of rice syrup.

8. Finally, add half a tablespoon of oyster sauce and stir-fry.

9. Add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and 1 tablespoon of cooking wine and stir-fry.

10. Finally, sprinkle a pinch of black pepper and 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds.

#TumisBawangPutih #DagingSapi #DagingCincang

-Bahan-bahan

300g daging sapi cincang, 300g bawang putih muda, 5 buah cabai Cheongyang, 2 sendok makan minyak zaitun

1 sendok makan bawang putih cincang, 2 sendok makan kecap asin, 1 sendok teh gula xylitol, 1 sendok teh sirup jahe

3g garam, 1 sendok makan besar sirup beras, 1/2 sendok makan saus tiram, 1 sendok makan minyak wijen, 1 sendok makan anggur masak

Sejumput lada hitam, 1 sendok makan biji wijen

- Resep

1. Cincang halus bawang putih muda.

2. Iris cabai Cheongyang dan cincang halus.

3. Masukkan daging sapi giling ke dalam wajan, tambahkan 2 sendok makan minyak zaitun dan 1 sendok makan bawang putih cincang, lalu tumis.

4. Setelah daging agak matang, tambahkan 2 sendok makan kecap asin, 1 sendok teh gula xylitol, dan 1 sendok teh sirup jahe, lalu tumis.

5. Tambahkan tangkai bawang putih dan cabai.

6. Tambahkan 3g garam dan tumis.

7. Tambahkan 1 sendok makan besar sirup beras.

8. Terakhir, tambahkan setengah sendok makan saus tiram dan tumis.

9. Tambahkan 1 sendok makan minyak wijen dan 1 sendok makan anggur masak, lalu tumis.

10. Terakhir, taburkan sedikit lada hitam dan 1 sendok makan biji wijen.

#닭구이 #닭다리살구이 #닭조림

-재료
닭다리살 700g, 천일염 1스푼, 밀가루 1스푼, 대파 3대, 소금 3꼬집
맛술 2스푼 , 마늘한줌, 돈가스소스 2스푼, 굴소스 반스푼, 후춧가루

-레시피
1. 닭다리살 700g, 천일염 1스푼, 밀가루 1스푼, 물 약간 넣고 주물러주세요.
2. 닭을 깨끗하게 물에 헹궈주세요.
3. 대파를 4cm 간격으로 썰어주세요.
4. 닭다리살 물기를 키친타올로 제거해주세요.
5. 두꺼운 닭다리살은 칼집을 넣어서 소금 3꼬집으로 밑간을 해주세요.
6. 팬에 닭다리살 껍질부분이 밑으로 가게 두고 맛술 2스푼 넣고 구워주세요.
7. 눌러가면서 노릇노릇하게 구워서 썰어주세요.
8. 대파, 마늘한줌 넣고 구워주세요.
9. 돈가스소스 2스푼, 굴소스 반스푼 넣고 약불로 줄여서 섞어주세요.
10. 마지막에 불 끄고 후춧가루를 넣어주세요.

id.title: Untuk ayam panggang dengan daun bawang, cukup siapkan saus 000 yang ada di rumah. Inilah rahasia ...
id.description:
#AyamPanggang #PahaAyamPanggang #AyamRebus

-Bahan-bahan
700g daging paha ayam, 1 sendok makan garam laut, 1 sendok makan tepung terigu, 3 batang daun bawang, 3 sejumput garam
2 sendok makan anggur masak, segenggam bawang putih, 2 sendok makan saus tonkatsu, 1/2 sendok makan saus tiram, lada hitam

-Resep

1. Campur 700g daging paha ayam dengan 1 sendok makan garam laut, 1 sendok makan tepung terigu, dan sedikit air, lalu lumuri hingga rata.

2. Bilas ayam hingga bersih dengan air.

3. Potong daun bawang dengan jarak 4cm.

4. Keringkan daging paha ayam dengan tisu dapur.

5. Buat sayatan pada daging paha ayam yang lebih tebal dan bumbui dengan 3 sejumput garam.

6. Letakkan daging paha ayam dengan kulit menghadap ke bawah di dalam wajan, tambahkan 2 sendok makan anggur masak, dan panggang. 7. Tekan sambil dipanggang hingga berwarna cokelat keemasan, lalu iris.

8. Tambahkan daun bawang dan segenggam bawang putih, lalu panggang.

9. Tambahkan 2 sendok makan saus tonkatsu dan setengah sendok makan saus tiram, kecilkan api, dan aduk.

10. Terakhir, matikan api dan tambahkan lada hitam.

en-US.title: For the grilled chicken with green onions, just prepare the 000 sauce you have at home. This is t...
en-US.description:
#GrilledChicken #GrilledChickenThighs #BraisedChicken

-Ingredients
700g chicken thigh meat, 1 tablespoon sea salt, 1 tablespoon flour, 3 green onions, 3 pinches of salt
2 tablespoons cooking wine, a handful of garlic, 2 tablespoons tonkatsu sauce, 1/2 tablespoon oyster sauce, black pepper

-Recipe

1. Mix 700g of chicken thigh meat with 1 tablespoon sea salt, 1 tablespoon flour, and a little water, then rub well.

2. Rinse the chicken thoroughly with water.

3. Cut the green onions into 4cm intervals.

4. Remove moisture from the chicken thigh meat with a kitchen towel.

5. Make incisions in the thicker chicken thigh meat and season with 3 pinches of salt.

6. Place the chicken thigh meat skin-side down in a pan, add 2 tablespoons of cooking wine, and grill. 7. Press down while grilling until golden brown, then slice.

8. Add green onions and a handful of garlic and grill.

9. Add 2 tablespoons of tonkatsu sauce and half a tablespoon of oyster sauce, reduce the heat to low, and mix.

10. Finally, turn off the heat and add black pepper.

#PerillaLeafKimchi #PerillaLeaves #SideDish

-Ingredients

10 bundles of perilla leaves (110 leaves), 140g chives, 4 red chili peppers, 1/2 onion (120g)

3 tablespoons dark soy sauce, 3 tablespoons soup soy sauce, 2 tablespoons anchovy sauce, 3 tablespoons plum extract, 2 tablespoons oligosaccharide

1 tablespoon minced garlic, 1/2 teaspoon ginger syrup, 5 tablespoons red chili powder, 5 tablespoons water, 2 tablespoons sesame seeds

-Recipe

1. Soak the perilla leaves in vinegar water for 5 minutes, then wash them.

2. Cut the perilla leaves, leaving about 1cm at the stems.

3. Julienne the onion.

4. Cut the chives into 2cm to 3cm intervals.

5. Halve the red chili peppers, remove the seeds, and slice them thinly. 6. Make the seasoning by mixing 3 tablespoons of regular soy sauce, 3 tablespoons of soup soy sauce, 2 tablespoons of anchovy sauce, 3 tablespoons of plum extract, 2 tablespoons of oligosaccharide, 1 tablespoon of minced garlic, 1/2 teaspoon of ginger syrup, 5 tablespoons of red pepper powder, 5 tablespoons of water, and 2 tablespoons of sesame seeds into the vegetables.

7. Layer 3 perilla leaves together and spread the seasoning over them.

10 ikat daun perilla (110 lembar), 140 g daun bawang, 4 buah cabai merah, 1/2 bawang bombai (120 g)

3 sendok makan kecap asin pekat, 3 sendok makan kecap asin bubuk, 2 sendok makan saus ikan teri, 3 sendok makan ekstrak plum, 2 sendok makan oligosakarida

snippet.title: " 브로콜리 이렇게 드시면 매일 드십니다 " 매일 먹어도 질리지 않는 맛!
snippet.description:
#브로콜리샐러드 #브로콜리무침 #요거트드레싱
-재료
브로콜리 1개, 식초 1스푼, 물 1.5리터, 밀가루 1스푼, 견과류
물 50ml, 삶은계란 3개, 들깨가루 3스푼, 아카시아꿀 20g
그릭요거트 3스푼, 진간장 1티스푼, 들기름 1티스푼, 통들깨 1스푼

-레시피
1. 물에 식초 1스푼 풀어서 집게로 브로콜리 줄기를 잡아서 5분 담가두세요.
2. 브로콜리를 씻어서 먹기 좋은 크기로 잘라주세요.
3. 물 1.5리터에 밀가루 1스푼 풀어서 브로콜리를 10분 담가두었다가 씻어주세요.
4. 브로콜리를 물 50ml 넣어서 전자렌지에 3분 익혀주세요.
5. 브로콜리를 건져두세요.
6. 삶은계란을 썰어주세요.
7. 들깨가루 3스푼, 아카시아꿀 20g, 그릭요거트 3스푼, 진간장 1티스푼, 들기름 1티스푼, 통들깨 1스푼 섞어주세요.
8. 브로콜리 넣고 섞어주세요.
9. 계란을 넣고 섞어주세요.
10. 견과류도 올려주세요.

en-US.title: "You'll eat broccoli every day if you make it like this" A taste you'll never get tired of!
en-US.description:
#BroccoliSalad #SeasonedBroccoli #YogurtDressing

-Ingredients

1 head of broccoli, 1 tablespoon vinegar, 1.5 liters water, 1 tablespoon flour, nuts

50ml water, 3 boiled eggs, 3 tablespoons perilla seed powder, 20g acacia honey

3 tablespoons Greek yogurt, 1 teaspoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon perilla oil, 1 tablespoon whole perilla seeds

-Recipe

1. Dissolve 1 tablespoon of vinegar in water. Hold the broccoli stem with tongs and soak for 5 minutes.

2. Wash the broccoli and cut it into bite-sized pieces.

3. Dissolve 1 tablespoon of flour in 1.5 liters of water, soak the broccoli for 10 minutes, and then wash it.

4. Add 50ml of water to the broccoli and cook in the microwave for 3 minutes.

5. Drain the broccoli. 6. Slice the boiled eggs.

7. Mix 3 tablespoons of perilla seed powder, 20g of acacia honey, 3 tablespoons of Greek yogurt, 1 teaspoon of soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of perilla oil, and 1 tablespoon of whole perilla seeds.

8. Add the broccoli and mix.

9. Add the eggs and mix.

10. Top with nuts.

-Bahan-bahan

1 kuntum brokoli, 1 sendok makan cuka, 1,5 liter air, 1 sendok makan tepung terigu, kacang-kacangan

50 ml air, 3 butir telur rebus, 3 sendok makan bubuk biji perilla, 20 g madu akasia

3 sendok makan yogurt Yunani, 1 sendok teh kecap asin, 1 sendok teh minyak perilla, 1 sendok makan biji perilla utuh

8. Tambahkan brokoli dan aduk rata.

9. Tambahkan telur dan aduk rata.

10. Taburi dengan kacang-kacangan.

snippet.description:
#돼지김치찌개 #김치찌개 #돼지찌개 
-재료
두부 300g, 돼지고기 찌개용 전지살 300g, 김치 1/4쪽, 대파 1대, 양파 100g
청양고추 2개, 김치국물 100ml, 파우더 사골육수 2개, 쌀뜨물 500ml
새우젓 1스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼, 다진생강 반티스푼, 식용유 2스푼
고춧가루 2스푼, 참치액 1스푼

-레시피
1. 대파를 어슷 썰어주세요.
2. 청양고추를 썰어주세요.
3. 양파를 큼직하게 썰어주세요.
4. 두부도 큼직하게 썰어주세요.
5. 팬에 식용유를 2스푼정도 두르고 돼지고기를 먼저 볶아주세요.
6. 새우젓 1스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼, 다진생강 반티스푼, 양파 넣고 볶아주세요.
7. 고춧가루 1스푼 넣고 중불로 줄여서 볶아주세요.
8. 김치를 썰어서 넣어 볶아주세요.
9. 파우더 사골육수 2개, 김치국물 100ml 넣고 볶아주세요.
10. 쌀뜨물 500ml 넣고 끓여주세요.
11. 대파 줄기부분만 먼저 넣고 10분 끓여주세요.
12. 남은 대파, 고추, 두부를 넣고 끓여주세요.
13. 간을 보고 부족한 간을 맞춰주세요.
      저는 참치액 1스푼, 고춧가루 1스푼 더 넣고 끓여줄게요.
14. 총 15분정도 끓여주시면 완성

id.title: 🔴SIARAN LANGSUNG: Resep “Sup Kimchi Daging Babi” ala Rumahan yang Pasti Enak dan Super Lezat
id.description:
#SupKimchiBabi #SupKimchi #SupBabi

-Bahan-bahan

300g tahu, 300g bahu babi untuk sup, 1/4 kepala kimchi, 1 daun bawang, 100g bawang bombai

2 cabai Cheongyang, 100ml air kimchi, 2 bungkus bubuk kaldu tulang sapi, 500ml air beras

1 sendok makan pasta udang asin, 1 sendok makan bawang putih cincang, 1/2 sendok teh jahe cincang, 2 sendok makan minyak goreng

2 sendok makan bubuk cabai merah, 1 sendok makan ekstrak tuna

-Resep

1. Iris daun bawang secara diagonal.

2. Iris cabai Cheongyang.

3. Potong bawang bombai menjadi potongan besar.

4. Potong tahu menjadi potongan besar juga.

5. Tuang sekitar 2 sendok makan minyak goreng ke dalam wajan dan tumis babi terlebih dahulu. 6. Tambahkan 1 sendok makan pasta udang asin, 1 sendok makan bawang putih cincang, setengah sendok teh jahe cincang, dan bawang bombai, lalu tumis.

7. Tambahkan 1 sendok makan bubuk cabai merah, kecilkan api menjadi sedang, dan tumis.

8. Iris kimchi, tambahkan, dan tumis.

9. Tambahkan 2 bungkus bubuk kaldu tulang sapi dan 100 ml air kimchi, lalu tumis.

10. Tambahkan 500 ml air beras dan didihkan.

11. Masukkan terlebih dahulu hanya batang daun bawang dan rebus selama 10 menit.

12. Tambahkan sisa daun bawang, cabai, dan tahu, lalu rebus.

13. Cicipi dan sesuaikan bumbu sesuai kebutuhan.

Saya akan menambahkan 1 sendok makan ekstrak tuna dan 1 sendok makan bubuk cabai merah lalu rebus.

14. Rebus selama kurang lebih 15 menit, dan selesai.

en-US.title: 🔴 Guaranteed Delicious, Incredible Flavor: Mom's "Pork Kimchi Stew" Made in a Snap Live Broadcast
en-US.description:
#PorkKimchiStew #KimchiStew #PorkStew

-Ingredients

300g tofu, 300g pork shoulder for stew, 1/4 head of kimchi, 1 green onion, 100g onion

2 Cheongyang peppers, 100ml kimchi juice, 2 packets beef bone broth powder, 500ml rice water

1 tablespoon salted shrimp paste, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, 1/2 teaspoon minced ginger, 2 tablespoons cooking oil

2 tablespoons red chili powder, 1 tablespoon tuna extract

-Recipe

1. Slice the green onion diagonally.

2. Slice the Cheongyang peppers.

3. Cut the onion into large chunks.

4. Cut the tofu into large chunks as well.

5. Pour about 2 tablespoons of cooking oil into a pan and stir-fry the pork first. 6. Add 1 tablespoon of salted shrimp paste, 1 tablespoon of minced garlic, half a teaspoon of minced ginger, and onion, then stir-fry.

7. Add 1 tablespoon of red pepper powder, reduce the heat to medium, and stir-fry.

8. Slice the kimchi, add it, and stir-fry.

9. Add 2 packets of beef bone broth powder and 100ml of kimchi juice, then stir-fry.

10. Add 500ml of rice water and bring to a boil.

11. Add only the stems of the green onions first and boil for 10 minutes.

12. Add the remaining green onions, chili peppers, and tofu, and boil.

13. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.

I will add 1 tablespoon of tuna extract and 1 tablespoon of red pepper powder and boil.

14. Boil for a total of about 15 minutes, and it is done.

snippet.description:
#상추물김치 #상추 #물김치
-재료
상추, 물 3.5리터, 천일염 3스푼, 쪽파 300g, 고춧가루 4스푼
양파 350g, 홍고추 200g, 사과 200g, 멸치액젓 8스푼, 물 3리터
새우젓 2스푼, 다진생강 반스푼, 통마늘 10개, 밀가루 2스푼
매실액 4스푼, 고운소금 5g( 1티스푼), 홍고추 2개(데코용)

-레시피
1. 물 3.5리터 천일염 3스푼 풀어주세요.
2. 상추를 소금물에 20분 절여주세요.
3. 쪽파를 썰어주세요.
4. 양파 350g 반은 채 썰고 반은 갈때 사용하게 썰어주세요.
5. 믹서기에 양파, 홍고추 200g, 사과 200g, 멸치액젓 6스푼, 새우젓 2스푼, 다진생강 반스푼, 통마늘 10개, 물 300ml 넣고 갈아주세요.
6. 고춧가루 4스푼도 같이 넣어서 갈아주세요.
7. 물 100ml에 밀가루 2스푼 풀어주세요.
8. 끓는물 400ml에 밀가루물을 부어서 풀을 쒀주세요.
9. 절인 상추를 건져주세요.
10. 물 2.2리터에 채반을 이용해서 갈은 양념을 풀어 건더기는 걸러주세요.
11. 풀물을 부어주세요.
12.  매실액 4스푼, 고운소금 5g( 1티스푼), 멸치액젓 2스푼 넣어주세요.
13. 썰은 채소를 넣어주세요.
14. 상추를 담으면서 국물을 중간중간 부어주세요.
15. 홍고추 2개 썰어서 데코로 올려주세요.

en-US.title: Water kimchi made with tons of lettuce doesn't need to be fermented. It's amazing if you eat it r...
en-US.description:
#LettuceWaterKimchi #Lettuce #WaterKimchi

-Ingredients

Lettuce, 3.5 liters of water, 3 tablespoons of sea salt, 300g of scallions, 4 tablespoons of red chili powder

350g of onion, 200g of red chili pepper, 200g of apple, 8 tablespoons of anchovy fish sauce, 3 liters of water

2 tablespoons of salted shrimp paste, 1/2 tablespoon of minced ginger, 10 cloves of whole garlic, 2 tablespoons of flour

4 tablespoons of plum extract, 5g of fine salt (1 teaspoon), 2 red chili peppers (for decoration)

-Recipe

1. Dissolve 3 tablespoons of sea salt in 3.5 liters of water.

2. Soak the lettuce in the salt water for 20 minutes.

3. Slice the scallions.

4. Julienne half of the 350g onion and slice the other half to use for grating. 5. Put the onion, 200g red chili peppers, 200g apples, 6 tablespoons anchovy fish sauce, 2 tablespoons salted shrimp paste, half a tablespoon minced ginger, 10 whole cloves of garlic, and 300ml water into a blender and blend.

6. Add 4 tablespoons of red chili powder and blend.

7. Dissolve 2 tablespoons of flour in 100ml of water.

8. Pour the flour mixture into 400ml of boiling water to make a paste.

9. Drain the pickled lettuce.

10. Dissolve the blended seasoning in 2.2 liters of water using a sieve and strain out the solids.

11. Pour in the paste mixture.

12. Add 4 tablespoons of plum extract, 5g of fine salt (1 teaspoon), and 2 tablespoons of anchovy fish sauce.

13. Add the chopped vegetables. 14. Pour the broth over the lettuce in between.

15. Slice 2 red chili peppers and place them on top for decoration.

#PotRice #BeefPotRice #ZucchiniPotRice

-Ingredients

200g minced beef, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon allulose, 2/3 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon minced garlic

1 tablespoon mirin, 1/3 teaspoon minced ginger, black pepper, 1 zucchini, 5g fine salt, 2 tablespoons water

3 stalks green onions, 1 tablespoon red pepper powder, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1/2 tablespoon allulose, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon water, 2 tablespoons sesame seeds

3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 pack oyster mushrooms, 2 bowls cooked rice, 1 egg, 3 tablespoons water

- Recipe

1. Wipe the blood off the ground beef with a kitchen towel.

2. To the ground beef, add 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon allulose, 2/3 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon minced garlic, 1 tablespoon mirin, and minced ginger Season with 1/3 teaspoon of ground black pepper.

3. Julienne 1 zucchini.

4. Add 5g of fine salt and about 2 tablespoons of water to the zucchini and let it marinate.

5. Chop the scallions.

6. Make the sauce by mixing 1 tablespoon of red pepper powder, the chopped scallions, 3 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1/2 tablespoon of allulose, 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, 1 tablespoon of water, and 2 tablespoons of sesame seeds.

7. Drizzle 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan and stir-fry the minced meat.

8. Remove the stir-fried meat and set it aside.

9. Rinse the marinated zucchini once in water, squeeze out the excess water, and place it in a pot.

10. Add the zucchini and 1 pack of oyster mushrooms and stir-fry briefly.

11. Add 2 bowls of rice.

12. Add 1 egg.

13. Add 3 tablespoons of water and cover with a lid. Once heated, reduce the heat to medium and cook for 5 minutes.

14. Add the beef and mix.

15. Add the seasoning sauce to taste and enjoy.

#NasiPot #NasiPotDagingSapi #NasiPotZucchini

-Bahan-bahan

200g daging sapi cincang, 1 sdm kecap asin, 1 sdm allulose, 2/3 sdm minyak wijen, 1 sendok teh bawang putih cincang

1 sdm mirin, 1/3 sendok teh jahe cincang, lada hitam, 1 buah zucchini, 5 g garam halus, 2 sdm air

3 batang daun bawang, 1 sdm bubuk cabai merah, 3 sdm kecap asin, 1/2 sdm allulose, 1 sdm minyak wijen, 1 sdm air, 2 sdm biji wijen

- Resep

2. Tambahkan 1 sdm kecap asin, 1 sdm allulose, 2/3 sdm minyak wijen, 1 sendok teh bawang putih cincang, 1 sdm mirin, dan jahe cincang ke daging sapi giling. Bumbui dengan 1/3 sendok teh lada hitam bubuk.

3. Iris tipis 1 buah zucchini.

4. Tambahkan 5g garam halus dan sekitar 2 sendok makan air ke dalam zucchini dan biarkan terendam.

5. Cincang daun bawang.

6. Buat saus dengan mencampur 1 sendok makan bubuk cabai merah, daun bawang cincang, 3 sendok makan kecap asin, 1/2 sendok makan allulose, 1 sendok makan minyak wijen, 1 sendok makan air, dan 2 sendok makan biji wijen.

11. Tambahkan 2 mangkuk nasi.

12. Tambahkan 1 butir telur.

13. Tambahkan 3 sendok makan air dan tutup panci. Setelah panas, kecilkan api menjadi sedang dan masak selama 5 menit.

14. Tambahkan daging sapi dan aduk rata.

15. Tambahkan saus bumbu sesuai selera dan sajikan.

400g Kubis, cuka, 1 sendok makan air, 3 batang daun bawang, 1 sendok makan biji wijen

#StirFriedCabbage #StirFriedEggs #CabbageDishes

-Ingredients

400g cabbage, vinegar 1 tablespoon water, 3 stalks of green onions, 1 tablespoon sesame seeds

5 pieces of carrot, 3 eggs, 1 pinch of salt, 4 tablespoons olive oil

1 tablespoon minced garlic, 1 tablespoon anchovy sauce, 1 teaspoon oyster sauce

2g salt, 1 tablespoon perilla oil, a pinch of black pepper, a pinch of peperoncino

- Recipe

1. Rinse the shredded cabbage.

2. Add 1 tablespoon of vinegar to the cabbage and soak it in water.

3. Chop 3 stalks of green onions.

4. Cut only 5 pieces of carrot and thinly julienne them.

5. Beat 3 eggs with a pinch of salt.

6. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan and make scrambled eggs.

7. Remove the scrambled eggs and drizzle 2 tablespoons of olive oil over them.

8. Add 1 tablespoon of minced garlic and half of the green onions first and stir-fry.

9. Moisture Add the removed cabbage and carrots and stir-fry.

10. Add 1 tablespoon of anchovy sauce and stir-fry the scrambled eggs together.

11. Add 1 teaspoon of oyster sauce and stir-fry.

12. Add the remaining scallions and adjust the seasoning with 2g of salt.

13. Turn off the heat, add 1 tablespoon of perilla oil and a pinch of black pepper, and mix.

14. Add a little peperoncino and 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds and mix.

3. 오이를 얇게 채 썰어주세요.
4. 고추를 다져주세요.
5. 가지를 찢어서 식혀주세요.
6. 가지에 국간장 1스푼, 갈은 천일염 1스푼, 다진마늘 1티스푼, 자일로스 설탕 1스푼, 매실액 2스푼, 참치액 1스푼, 깨 1스푼, 식초 3스푼, 오이, 고추를 넣고 섞어주세요.

en-US.title: 🔴“The secret to a refreshing and clean taste: Cold Eggplant Soup, right here! " Dduk-ddak Live Br...
en-US.description:
#ColdEggplantSoup #ColdCucumberSoup #ColdSoup

-Ingredients

3 eggplants, 1 cucumber, 1 red chili pepper, 2 Cheongyang chili peppers, 1 tablespoon soup soy sauce, 1 tablespoon ground sea salt, 1 teaspoon minced garlic, 1 tablespoon xylitol sugar, 2 tablespoons plum extract, 1 tablespoon tuna extract, 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, 600ml kelp broth, 3 tablespoons vinegar

-Recipe

1. Cut the eggplants into large pieces.

2. Place the eggplants in a steamer and steam for 5 to 6 minutes.

3. Thinly julienne the cucumbers.

4. Chop the chili peppers.

5. Tear the eggplants apart and let them cool. 6. Add 1 tablespoon of soup soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of ground sea salt, 1 teaspoon of minced garlic, 1 tablespoon of xylitol sugar, 2 tablespoons of plum extract, 1 tablespoon of tuna extract, 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds, 3 tablespoons of vinegar, cucumber, and chili pepper to the eggplant and mix.

7. Pour in 600ml of kelp broth.

8. (If adding ice, adjust the seasoning by adding more soup soy sauce or salt.)

en-US.title: "Scallions wrapped around pork belly! Here's an amazing combination! Do you still eat pork belly ...
en-US.description:
#PickledScallions #Scallions #Pickles

-Ingredients

-Ingredients
700g scallions, 200ml water, 200ml soy sauce, 100ml brown sugar, 2 sheets of kelp, 3 shiitake mushrooms, 1 tablespoon sea salt, 1 teaspoon black pepper, 2 red chili peppers, 7 Cheongyang chili peppers, 200ml rice wine, 200ml vinegar

-Recipe

1. Cut off the roots of the scallions and peel off one layer of the outer skin.

2. Wash the scallions and cut off only the tips.

3. Wipe off the moisture.

4. Add 200ml water, 200ml soy sauce, 100ml brown sugar, 2 sheets of kelp, 3 shiitake mushrooms, 1 tablespoon sea salt, and 1 teaspoon black pepper, then bring to a boil.

5. After 5 minutes, remove the kelp. 6. Pour in 200ml of Cheongju and 200ml of vinegar and let it cool.

7. Slice 2 red chili peppers and 7 Cheongyang chili peppers diagonally.

8. Place the chili peppers in between the scallions in a container.

9. Remove the mushrooms and pour in the soy sauce.

10. Press down with a plate and close the lid.

(Turn it upside down once after one day.)

11. Eat after 2 days. Store in a kimchi refrigerator and enjoy.

snippet.title: 아침식사로 가볍게 이거 어떠세요? " 밥 없이도 맛있는 계란오믈렛 "
snippet.description:
#토마토오믈렛 #오믈렛 #계란오믈렛
-재료
쪽파 32g, 파프리카 25g, 토마토 120g, 계란 3개, 소금 4꼬집
다진마늘 1티스푼, 모차렐라치즈 한줌

-레시피
1. 쪽파 32g, 파프리카 25g, 토마토 120g 다져주세요.
2. 계란 3개, 소금 2꼬집 풀어주세요. 
3. 팬에 식용유를 두르고 다진마늘 1티스푼 , 쪽파 2스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
4. 토마토, 파프리카, 소금 2꼬집 넣고 볶아주세요.
5. 볶은걸 덜어 놓고 팬을 닦아서 기름을 다시 둘러주세요.
6. 계란을 붓고 남은 쪽파를 골고루 뿌려주세요.
7. 한쪽에 볶은 토마토를 올려주세요.
8. 토마토 위에 모차렐라치즈 한줌 올려주세요.
9. 계란이 익으면 반으로 접어서 뚜껑을 엎어 치즈를 녹여주세요.
10. 토치 있으면 치즈에 토치를 해주세요.

id.title: Bagaimana dengan ini untuk sarapan ringan? "Omelet telur yang lezat meskipun tanpa nasi"
id.description:
#OmeletTomat #Omelet #OmeletTelur

-Bahan-bahan

32g daun bawang, 25g paprika, 120g tomat, 3 butir telur, 4 sejumput garam

1 sendok teh bawang putih cincang, segenggam keju mozzarella

-Resep

1. Cincang 32g daun bawang, 25g paprika, dan 120g tomat.

2. Kocok 3 butir telur dengan 2 sejumput garam.

3. Olesi wajan dengan minyak goreng, tambahkan 1 sendok teh bawang putih cincang dan 2 sendok makan daun bawang, lalu tumis.

4. Tambahkan tomat, paprika, dan 2 sejumput garam, lalu tumis.

5. Angkat bahan yang sudah ditumis, bersihkan wajan, dan olesi kembali dengan minyak.

6. Tuang campuran telur dan taburi sisa daun bawang secara merata.

7. Letakkan tomat yang sudah ditumis di satu sisi. 8. Letakkan segenggam keju mozzarella di atas tomat.

9. Setelah telur matang, lipat menjadi dua, balikkan tutupnya, dan lelehkan keju.

10. Jika Anda memiliki alat pembakar, bakar keju tersebut.

en-US.title: How about this for a light breakfast? "Delicious egg omelet even without rice"
en-US.description:
#TomatoOmelette #Omelette #EggOmelette

-Ingredients

32g green onions, 25g bell pepper, 120g tomatoes, 3 eggs, 4 pinches of salt

1 teaspoon minced garlic, a handful of mozzarella cheese

-Recipe

1. Chop 32g of green onions, 25g of bell pepper, and 120g of tomatoes.

2. Beat 3 eggs with 2 pinches of salt.

3. Coat a pan with cooking oil, add 1 teaspoon of minced garlic and 2 tablespoons of green onions, and sauté.

4. Add the tomatoes, bell pepper, and 2 pinches of salt, and sauté.

5. Remove the sautéed ingredients, wipe the pan clean, and re-coat with oil.

6. Pour in the egg mixture and sprinkle the remaining green onions evenly.

7. Place the sautéed tomatoes on one side. 8. Place a handful of mozzarella cheese on top of the tomato.

9. Once the egg is cooked, fold it in half, turn the lid upside down, and melt the cheese.

10. If you have a torch, torch the cheese.

snippet.title: 🔴 “냉장고 일주일 두어도 물이 안나오는 가지볶음! ” 뚝딱 생방송
snippet.description:
#가지반찬 #가지요리 #가지볶음
-재료
가지 3개, 소금 1티스푼, 물엿 2스푼, 꽈리고추 100g
멸치 40g, 소금 2꼬집, 올리브유 3스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼
진간장 2스푼, 미림 1스푼, 물엿 1스푼, 고춧가루 1스푼
참기름 1스푼, 깨 1스푼 

-레시피
1. 가지를 먹기 좋은 크기로 썰어주세요.
2. 가지에 소금 1티스푼, 물엿 2스푼 넣고 절여주세요.
3. 꽈리고추에 포크로 구멍을 찔러주세요.
4. 팬에 멸치를 기름없이 볶아주세요.
5. 10분정도 절인 가지를 물기없이 짜주세요.
6. 팬에 올리브유 3스푼 두르고 꽈리고추,  소금 2꼬집 넣고 볶아주세요. 
7. 다진마늘 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
8. 가지를 넣고 볶아주세요.
9. 진간장 2스푼, 미림 1스푼, 물엿 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
10. 볶아지면 고춧가루 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
11. 다 볶아지면 불 끄고 참기름 1스푼, 깨 1스푼 넣고 섞어주세요.

en-US.title: 🔴 “Stir-fried eggplant that doesn’t release water even after a week in the refrigerator!” Dduk-dd...
en-US.description:
#EggplantSideDish #EggplantDish #StirFriedEggplant

-Ingredients

3 eggplants, 1 teaspoon salt, 2 tablespoons corn syrup, 100g Korean chili peppers

40g anchovies, 2 pinches salt, 3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon minced garlic

2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon mirin, 1 tablespoon corn syrup, 1 tablespoon red chili powder

1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon sesame seeds

-Recipe

1. Cut the eggplants into bite-sized pieces.

2. Add 1 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of corn syrup to the eggplants and let them marinate.

3. Pierce holes in the Korean chili peppers with a fork.

4. Stir-fry the anchovies in a pan without oil.

5. Squeeze out all the moisture from the eggplants that have been marinated for about 10 minutes. 6. Drizzle 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan, add the Korean chili peppers and 2 pinches of salt, and stir-fry.

7. Add 1 tablespoon of minced garlic and stir-fry.

8. Add the eggplant and stir-fry.

9. Add 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of mirin, and 1 tablespoon of corn syrup and stir-fry.

10. Once stir-fried, add 1 tablespoon of red pepper powder and stir-fry.

11. When everything is cooked, turn off the heat, add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds, and mix.

ko.title: 🔴 “냉장고 일주일 두어도 물이 안나오는 가지볶음! ” 뚝딱 생방송
ko.description:
#가지반찬 #가지요리 #가지볶음
-재료
가지 3개, 소금 1티스푼, 물엿 2스푼, 꽈리고추 100g
멸치 40g, 소금 2꼬집, 올리브유 3스푼, 다진마늘 1스푼
진간장 2스푼, 미림 1스푼, 물엿 1스푼, 고춧가루 1스푼
참기름 1스푼, 깨 1스푼 

-레시피
1. 가지를 먹기 좋은 크기로 썰어주세요.
2. 가지에 소금 1티스푼, 물엿 2스푼 넣고 절여주세요.
3. 꽈리고추에 포크로 구멍을 찔러주세요.
4. 팬에 멸치를 기름없이 볶아주세요.
5. 10분정도 절인 가지를 물기없이 짜주세요.
6. 팬에 올리브유 3스푼 두르고 꽈리고추,  소금 2꼬집 넣고 볶아주세요. 
7. 다진마늘 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
8. 가지를 넣고 볶아주세요.
9. 진간장 2스푼, 미림 1스푼, 물엿 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
10. 볶아지면 고춧가루 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
11. 다 볶아지면 불 끄고 참기름 1스푼, 깨 1스푼 넣고 섞어주세요.

snippet.title: 두릅 초장 찍먹 그만!! " 두릅 이렇게 드시면 처음 드시는 분들도 다 좋아하세요 "
snippet.description:
#두릅전#두릅 #두릅요리

-재료
두릅 150g, 물 1리터, 천일염 반스푼, 계란 3개, 소금 2g
참기름 1티스푼, 부침가루 2스푼, 식용유 

-레시피
1. 끓는 물 1리터에 천일염 반스푼 넣어주세요.

7. 두릅을 계란을 묻혀서 구워주세요.

en-US.title: Stop dipping fiddlehead ferns in gochujang!! If you eat them like this, even first-time eaters wi...
en-US.description:
#DureupJeon #Dureup #DureupDish

-Ingredients

150g Dureup (Korean angelica tree shoots), 1 liter of water, 1/2 teaspoon of sea salt, 3 eggs, 2g of salt

1 teaspoon of sesame oil, 2 tablespoons of pancake mix, cooking oil

-Recipe

1. Add 1/2 teaspoon of sea salt to 1 liter of boiling water.

2. Put the Dureup shoots in root first, wait 10 seconds, then add the rest and blanch for another 30 seconds.

3. Rinse the Dureup shoots in cold water.

4. Add 3 eggs, 2g of salt, and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil and whisk together.

5. Coat the Dureup shoots evenly with 2 tablespoons of pancake mix.

6. Pour a generous amount of cooking oil into a pan.

7. Coat the Dureup shoots in the egg mixture and fry them.

id.description:
#DureupJeon #Dureup #HidanganDureup

-Bahan-bahan

150g Dureup (rebung pohon angelica Korea), 1 liter air, 1/2 sendok teh garam laut, 3 butir telur, 2g garam

1 sendok teh minyak wijen, 2 sendok makan adonan pancake, minyak goreng

-Resep

1. Tambahkan 1/2 sendok teh garam laut ke dalam 1 liter air mendidih.

2. Masukkan rebung Dureup dengan bagian akar terlebih dahulu, tunggu 10 detik, lalu tambahkan sisanya dan rebus selama 30 detik lagi.

3. Bilas rebung Dureup dengan air dingin.

4. Tambahkan 3 butir telur, 2g garam, dan 1 sendok teh minyak wijen, lalu kocok hingga rata.

5. Lumuri rebung Dureup secara merata dengan 2 sendok makan adonan pancake.

6. Tuang minyak goreng secukupnya ke dalam wajan.

7. Lumuri tunas Dureup dengan campuran telur dan goreng.

snippet.title: "시원 깔끔한 열무물김치 맛 비결 ? " 찹쌀풀 대신 이거죠!
snippet.description:
#열무물김치 #열무김치 
-재료
열무 900g, 얼갈이 1.5kg, 물 3리터, 천일염 400ml, 감자 300g, 물 100ml
물 4리터, 쪽파 200g, 홍고추 5개, 양파 2개(200g), 사과 1개
새우젓 2스푼, 멸치액젓 100ml, 매실액 4스푼, 고춧가루 200ml 
천일염 1스푼, 다진생강 1스푼, 다진마늘 3스푼


-레시피
1. 얼갈이 뿌리를 잘라내고 속을 털고 긴거는 반으로 잘라주세요.
2. 열무는 겉잎 떼어내고 잎부분은 일부만 놔두고 잘라서 손질해주세요.
3. 물 3리터에 천일염 200ml 풀어주세요.
4. 열무 얼갈이를 소금물에 적셔서 천일염 200ml로 나눠서 뿌려주면서 절여주세요.
5. 감자 300g 썰어서 물 100ml 넣고 전자렌지에 익혀주세요.
6. 쪽파를 뿌리쪽은 다지고 줄기는 3cm 정도 길이로 썰어주세요.
7. 홍고추 칼집 넣어서 다져주세요.
8. 양파 1개 반은 채 썰고 반은 갈때 사용할게요.
9. 믹서기에 양파 반개, 사과 1개, 익은감자, 새우젓 2스푼, 멸치액젓 100ml, 매실액 4스푼 넣고 갈아주세요.
10.  4리터 물에 (물은 여기서 350ml만 미리 빼두세요) 갈은 재료를 채반에 걸러서 넣어주세요.
11. 빼 둔 350ml 물에 고춧가루 200ml 풀어 불려두세요.
12. 채반에 천일염 1스푼 넣고 양념물에 풀어주세요.
13. 20분 불린 고춧가루물도 채반에 부어서 걸러서 넣어주세요.
14. 썰어 넣은 재료를 국물에 넣어주세요.
14. 다진생강 1스푼, 다진마늘 3스푼 넣어주세요.
15. 절인 열무, 얼갈이에 물을 부어서 건져주세요. (절이는 중간에 한번 뒤집어주세요)
16. 김치통에 열무 얼갈이를 담으면서 국물도 중간중간 부어주세요.
17. 상온에 하루정도 익혀주세요.

id.title: "Rahasia rasa Yeolmu Mul Kimchi yang menyegarkan dan bersih? Bukannya menggunakan pasta beras ket...
id.description:
#KimchiAirLobakMuda #KimchiLobakMuda

-Bahan-bahan

900g lobak muda, 1,5kg talas, 3 liter air, 400ml garam laut, 300g kentang, 100ml air

4 liter air, 200g daun bawang, 5 cabai merah, 2 bawang bombai (200g), 1 apel

2 sendok makan pasta udang asin, 100ml saus ikan teri, 4 sendok makan ekstrak plum, 200ml bubuk cabai merah

1 sendok makan garam laut, 1 sendok makan jahe cincang, 3 sendok makan bawang putih cincang

-Resep

1. Potong akar talas, buang daun bagian dalam, dan potong daun yang panjang menjadi dua.

2. Buang daun bagian luar lobak muda, potong daunnya hingga tersisa sebagian, dan siapkan sisanya dengan memotong.

3. Larutkan 200ml garam laut dalam 3 liter air. 4. Rendam lobak muda dan sawi putih dalam air garam, lalu taburi 200 ml garam laut sedikit demi sedikit untuk mengawetkannya.

5. Iris 300 g kentang, tambahkan 100 ml air, dan masak dalam microwave.

6. Cincang akar daun bawang dan potong batangnya sepanjang 3 cm.

7. Sayat cabai merah dan cincang halus.

8. Iris tipis satu setengah bawang bombai, dan gunakan setengahnya lagi untuk dihaluskan.

9. Masukkan setengah bawang bombai, satu apel, kentang yang sudah dimasak, 2 sendok makan pasta udang asin, 100 ml saus ikan teri, dan 4 sendok makan ekstrak plum ke dalam blender dan haluskan.

10. Saring bahan-bahan yang sudah dihaluskan melalui saringan dan tambahkan ke dalam 4 liter air (sisihkan 350 ml air terlebih dahulu).

11. Larutkan 200 ml bubuk cabai merah dalam 350 ml air yang telah disiapkan dan biarkan merendam. 12. Masukkan 1 sendok makan garam laut ke dalam saringan dan larutkan dalam air bumbu.

13. Tuangkan air cabai merah yang telah direndam selama 20 menit ke dalam saringan, saring, dan tambahkan ke dalam campuran.

14. Tambahkan bahan-bahan yang telah dicincang ke dalam kaldu.

14. Tambahkan 1 sendok makan jahe cincang dan 3 sendok makan bawang putih cincang.

15. Siram air ke atas lobak muda dan sawi putih yang telah diasamkan dan tiriskan. (Balikkan sekali selama proses pengasinan.)

16. Saat Anda memasukkan lobak muda dan sawi putih ke dalam wadah kimchi, siram kaldu di atasnya sesekali.

17. Biarkan berfermentasi pada suhu ruang selama sekitar satu hari.

en-US.title: "The secret to the refreshing and clean taste of Yeolmu Mul Kimchi? Instead of glutinous rice pas...
en-US.description:
#YoungRadishWaterKimchi #YoungRadishKimchi

-Ingredients

900g young radish, 1.5kg Chinese cabbage, 3 liters water, 400ml sea salt, 300g potatoes, 100ml water

4 liters water, 200g chives, 5 red chili peppers, 2 onions (200g), 1 apple

2 tablespoons salted shrimp paste, 100ml anchovy sauce, 4 tablespoons plum extract, 200ml red chili powder

1 tablespoon sea salt, 1 tablespoon minced ginger, 3 tablespoons minced garlic

-Recipe

1. Cut off the roots of the Chinese cabbage, remove the inner leaves, and cut the long ones in half.

2. Remove the outer leaves of the young radish, trim the leaves leaving only a portion, and prepare the rest by cutting.

3. Dissolve 200ml of sea salt in 3 liters of water. 4. Soak the young radish and Chinese cabbage in saltwater, then sprinkle 200ml of sea salt over them in portions to pickle them.

5. Slice 300g of potatoes, add 100ml of water, and cook them in the microwave.

6. Chop the roots of the scallions and cut the stems into 3cm lengths.

7. Score the red chili pepper and chop it finely.

8. Slice one and a half onions thinly, and use the other half for blending.

9. Put half an onion, one apple, the cooked potatoes, 2 tablespoons of salted shrimp paste, 100ml of anchovy sauce, and 4 tablespoons of plum extract into a blender and blend.

10. Strain the blended ingredients through a sieve and add them to 4 liters of water (set aside 350ml of water beforehand).

11. Dissolve 200ml of red chili powder in the reserved 350ml of water and let it soak. 12. Place 1 spoonful of sea salt in a sieve and dissolve it in the seasoning water.

13. Pour the red pepper water, soaked for 20 minutes, into the sieve as well, strain it, and add it to the mixture.

14. Add the chopped ingredients to the broth.

14. Add 1 spoonful of minced ginger and 3 spoonfuls of minced garlic.

15. Pour water over the pickled young radish and Chinese cabbage and drain them. (Turn them over once during the pickling process.)

16. As you pack the young radish and Chinese cabbage into a kimchi container, pour the broth over them occasionally.

17. Let it ferment at room temperature for about a day.

snippet.description:
#청경채김치 #청경채 #김치
-재료
손질 후 청경채 3.5kg, 물 2.5리터, 천일염 300ml, 물 200ml, 밀가루 1스푼
쪽파 200g, 건고추 50g(불려주세요), 홍고추 100g, 고춧가루 200ml 
양파 100g, 무 100g, 배 200g, 사과 200g, 멸치액젓 100ml, 새우젓 3스푼 
다진마늘 3스푼, 생강청 1티스푼, 매실액 4스푼

-레시피
1, 청경채를 씻어서 반으로 잘라서 큰거는 칼집을 넣어주세요.
2. 물 2.5리터에 천일염 200ml 풀어주세요.
3. 청경채를 소금물에 적셔서 천일염 100ml로 골고루 뿌려서 절여주세요.
4. 물 200ml에 밀가루 1스푼 풀어서 풀물을 쒀주세요.
5. 쪽파를 썰어주세요.
6. 믹서기에 양파 100g, 무 100g, 배 200g, 사과 200g, 멸치액젓 100ml, 새우젓 3스푼 넣고 갈아주세요.
7. 불린 건고추, 홍고추, 물 150ml 넣고 갈아주세요.
8. 갈은 양념을 붓고 믹서기에 물 50ml 넣고 헹궈서 넣으세요.
9. 풀도 넣어주세요.
10. 고춧가루 200ml 넣어주세요.
11. 다진마늘 3스푼, 생강청 1티스푼 섞어주세요.
12. 매실액 4스푼 섞어주세요.
13. 40분 절이고 물을 부어서 건져서 짜주세요. (절이는 중간에 한번 뒤집어주세요)
14. 물기를 30분 빼주세요.
15. 양념에 쪽파도 섞어주세요.
16. 물기 뺀 청경채를 양념에 버무려주세요.

en-US.title: 🔴 Quick and Easy Bok Choy Kimchi That Surprises You with Its Crunchy and Refreshing Taste Live Br...
en-US.description:
#BokChoyKimchi #BokChoy #Kimchi

-Ingredients

3.5kg cleaned bok choy, 2.5 liters water, 300ml sea salt, 200ml water, 1 tablespoon flour

200g green onions, 50g dried chili peppers (please soak), 100g red chili peppers, 200ml red chili powder

100g onion, 100g radish, 200g pear, 200g apple, 100ml anchovy sauce, 3 tablespoons salted shrimp paste

3 tablespoons minced garlic, 1 teaspoon ginger syrup, 4 tablespoons plum extract

-Recipe

1. Wash the bok choy, cut it in half, and make incisions in the larger ones.

2. Dissolve 200ml of sea salt in 2.5 liters of water. 3. Soak the bok choy in saltwater, then sprinkle evenly with 100ml of sea salt to marinate it.

4. Dissolve 1 tablespoon of flour in 200ml of water to make a paste.

5. Chop the scallions.

6. Put 100g of onion, 100g of radish, 200g of pear, 200g of apple, 100ml of anchovy fish sauce, and 3 tablespoons of salted shrimp paste into a blender and blend.

7. Add the soaked dried chili peppers, red chili peppers, and 150ml of water and blend.

8. Pour in the blended seasoning, add 50ml of water to the blender to rinse the ingredients, and add them to the mixture.

9. Add the paste.

10. Add 200ml of red chili powder.

11. Mix in 3 tablespoons of minced garlic and 1 teaspoon of ginger syrup.

12. Mix in 4 tablespoons of plum extract. 13. Marinate for 40 minutes, then pour in water, drain, and squeeze out the excess water. (Turn them over once during the marinating process.)

14. Drain the water for 30 minutes.

15. Mix the chopped scallions into the seasoning.

16. Toss the drained bok choy with the seasoning.

en-US.title: "Crispy eggplant pancakes without flour!!!" Try eating them this way during eggplant season.
en-US.description:
#EggplantJeon #EggplantDish #Jeon

-Ingredients

3 eggplants, rice paper, 120ml water, 6g salt

Carrot, 3 stalks of green onion, 2 Cheongyang peppers, 2 eggs

-Recipe

1. Slice the eggplants thinly.

2. Dissolve 5g of salt in 120ml of water and marinate the eggplants.

3. Julienne the carrots and marinate them together with the eggplants.

4. Chop 3 stalks of green onion and 2 Cheongyang peppers.

5. Add 2 eggs, 1g of salt, the chopped green onion, and the chopped Cheongyang peppers and mix well.

6. Drain the eggplants and squeeze out the excess water.

7. Mix the eggplants with the egg mixture.

8. Coat a pan with cooking oil, place a rice paper on top, spread out the eggplant slices, cover with the rice paper, and fry. 9. Once the eggplant is fully cooked, place an additional sheet of rice paper on each side and grill it for a crispier and tastier result.

-Recipe

3. After 10 minutes, remove only the kelp first.

4. Boil for another 5 minutes, then remove the shiitake mushrooms and let it cool.

5. Pour in 400ml of plum extract, 1 bottle of soju, and 400ml of vinegar.

6. Pour over the wild garlic leaves.

7. After half a day, turn the contents over.

8. Press down firmly to prevent it from floating and store.

9. Consume after one week.

#SeasonedCabbage #StirFriedCabbage #Cabbage

-Ingredients

600g cabbage, 5 stalks green onions, 7 eggs, 2 pinches of salt

1.5 liters water, 1 tablespoon sea salt, 1 tablespoon cooking oil

1 teaspoon minced garlic, 1.5 tablespoons anchovy sauce

1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, black pepper

-Recipe

1. Chop the green onions. 2. Wash the cabbage and tear it into bite-sized pieces.

3. Add 1 tablespoon of sea salt and 1 tablespoon of cooking oil to 1.5 liters of water and blanch the cabbage for 2 minutes.

4. Coat a pan with olive oil, sprinkle 2 pinches of salt over 7 eggs, and fry them.

5. Slice the fried eggs.

6. Add 1 teaspoon of minced garlic, 1 and a half tablespoons of anchovy sauce, 2 tablespoons of chopped scallions, 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds, and black pepper to the eggs and cabbage, then mix well.

#LettuceGimbap #TunaGimbap #CucumberTunaGimbap

-Ingredients

4 cucumbers, 1/2 teaspoon fine salt, 2.5 liters boiling water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, outer green lettuce leaves

250g tuna, 2 Cheongyang peppers, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard (or 2 pinches of salt), 3 tablespoons mayonnaise

2 bowls of rice, 1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt, 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame oil

-Recipe

1. 1. Wash 4 cucumbers, remove the seeds, and julienne only the outer parts.

2. Add half a teaspoon of fine salt to the cucumbers and let them marinate.

3. Add half a teaspoon of salt to 2.5 liters of boiling water, dip the lettuce in briefly, then immediately remove it and rinse it in cold water.

4. Wipe the lettuce dry.

5. Finely chop 2 Cheongyang peppers.

6. Mix the chopped Cheongyang peppers, 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard (or 2 pinches of salt), and 3 tablespoons of mayonnaise into the drained tuna.

7. Add half a teaspoon of seasoned salt and 1 and a half tablespoons of sesame oil to 2 cups of rice and mix.

8. Squeeze out the excess water from the marinated cucumbers.

9. Cover the sushi mat with plastic wrap.

10. Spread the lettuce evenly on the mat, overlapping it completely.

11. Spread the rice over the lettuce. 12. Place the pickled cucumber and tuna on top and roll it up.

13. Be sure to cover it with plastic wrap when slicing.

#ScallionSalad #Scallions #ScallionDish

-Ingredients

370g scallions, 1.5 liters water, 1/2 teaspoon sea salt

1/2 teaspoon anchovy sauce, 1/2 teaspoon regular soy sauce, 2/3 teaspoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon sesame seeds

-Recipe

1. Cut the prepared scallions in half.

2. Add 1/2 teaspoon of sea salt to 1.5 liters of water and bring to a boil. 3. Put the root part in first, and after 30 seconds, add the leaf part and blanch for another 10 seconds.

4. Remove from the water, rinse in cold water, and squeeze out the excess moisture.

5. Add half a spoonful of anchovy sauce, half a spoonful of regular soy sauce, 2/3 spoonful of sesame oil, and 1 spoonful of sesame seeds, then mix well.

#CucumberWaterKimchi #CucumberJjabaki #CucumberKimchi

-Ingredients

10 cucumbers, 100g green onions, 2 tablespoons sea salt, 4 liters water, 4 tablespoons salted shrimp paste

Half an onion, 1 red chili pepper, 4 Cheongyang chili peppers, 3 tablespoons fine red chili powder

Half a bowl of cooked rice, half an onion, 1 apple, 6 red chili peppers, a handful of garlic, ginger 1 tablespoon

4 tablespoons anchovy sauce, 2 tablespoons fine salt, 4 tablespoons plum extract, 1 tablespoon sea salt

- Recipe

1. Wash the cucumber, cut it in half, and slice it into bite-sized pieces.

2. Add 2 tablespoons of sea salt to the cucumber, pour boiling water over it, and let it sit for 5 minutes.

3. Rinse the cucumber and set it aside.

4. Slice the chives to the same length as the cucumber.

5. Julienne half an onion, 1 red chili pepper, and 4 Cheongyang chili peppers.

6. Put half a bowl of cooked rice, half an onion, 1 apple, 6 red chili peppers, a handful of garlic, 1 tablespoon ginger, 400ml water, and 4 tablespoons salted shrimp paste into a blender and blend.

7. Strain the blended seasoning finely.

8. Pour in 3.6 liters of water. 9. Add 3 tablespoons of fine red pepper powder.

10. Add 4 tablespoons of anchovy sauce, 2 tablespoons of fine salt, 4 tablespoons of plum extract, and 1 tablespoon of sea salt to adjust the seasoning.

11. Add the shredded ingredients.

12. Add the cucumbers.

13. Taste the dish individually and adjust the seasoning with salt or shrimp paste if needed.

en-US.title: "Mushrooms taste like this?!" Here is a shiitake mushroom dish you absolutely must try 🥇
en-US.description:
#GrilledShiitakeMushrooms #ShiitakeMushrooms #RicePaper

-Ingredients

8 shiitake mushrooms, 30g unsalted butter, 1 pinch of salt, 8 sheets of rice paper, cooking oil

-Recipe

1. Remove the stems from the shiitake mushrooms, wash them, and dry them.

2. Sprinkle a pinch of salt on the inside of each of the 8 mushrooms.

3. Divide the 30g of unsalted butter among them and place it on top.

4. Dip the rice paper in water, remove it, and wrap the shiitake mushrooms.

5. Drizzle a generous amount of cooking oil in a pan and grill the shiitake mushrooms until golden brown.

#Curry #VegetableCurry #CabbageCurry

-Recipe

1. Cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces and soak them in water.

2. Soak the cabbage in vinegar water as well, then cut it into bite-sized pieces.

3. Cut the onions and carrots into pieces the same size as the potatoes.

10. Finally, add black pepper.

#YoungRadishKimchi #AltariKimchi #Altari

-Ingredients
3 bunches of cleaned Altari radishes (6kg), 2 cups of sea salt (400ml), 500ml of water

300ml of water, 4 tablespoons of glutinous rice flour, 100g of green onions, 30g of Japanese scallions

110g of onions, 110g of apples, 1 tablespoon of ginger, 4 tablespoons of salted shrimp paste, 100ml of anchovy fish sauce

50ml of concentrated anchovy paste, 5 tablespoons of plum extract, 5 tablespoons of minced garlic, 400ml of red chili powder

Powder 2 packets of beef bone broth, 3 tablespoons of fine red pepper powder

3 tablespoons of anchovy paste, 1 tablespoon of sea salt, 3 tablespoons of plum extract

- Recipe

1. Wash the radishes thoroughly and remove any yellow leaves or hairs.

2. Cut off the black parts of the heads with a knife.

3. Arrange the radishes in a zigzag pattern and sprinkle them with 2 cups of sea salt to pickle them.

Dissolve the remaining salt in 500ml of water and pour it over the radishes.

4. Make a paste by mixing 4 tablespoons of glutinous rice flour into 300ml of water.

5. Slice the green onions thinly.

6. Slice the chives as well. 7. Add 110g of onion, 110g of apple, 1 tablespoon of ginger, 4 tablespoons of salted shrimp paste, 100ml of anchovy fish sauce, 50ml of concentrated anchovy paste, and 5 tablespoons of plum extract, then blend.

8. Add 5 tablespoons of minced garlic, glutinous rice paste, and 400ml of red pepper powder to the blended ingredients.

9. Add 2 packets of beef bone broth powder. (Anchovy stock can be substituted.)

10. Add green onions and chives and mix.

11. Rinse the radishes, which have been marinated for 1 hour, once in water and drain.

12. If the leaves are long, cut them in half, and slice the radishes into quarters.

13. Add 3 tablespoons of fine red pepper powder to the radishes and mix.

14. Add the seasoning and mix. 15. Adjust the seasoning by adding 3 tablespoons of anchovy paste, 1 tablespoon of sea salt, and 3 tablespoons of plum extract.

16. Let it ferment for 4 or 5 days.

#MugwortPancake #MugwortGreens #SpringGreens

-Ingredients

150g mugwort, 1 tablespoon flour, 2 Cheongyang chili peppers, 1 red chili pepper, 200ml sparkling water

150ml pancake mix, 150ml frying powder, 2 potatoes, 2 teaspoons anchovy sauce

-Recipe

1. Before washing, trim the mugwort, add 1 tablespoon of flour, and wash thoroughly.

2. Finely chop 2 Cheongyang chili peppers and 1 red chili pepper.

3. Put 2 potatoes and 200ml of sparkling water into a blender and blend.

4. Add the blended potatoes, chopped chili peppers, 150ml pancake mix, and 150ml frying powder to the mugwort and mix.

5. If potatoes are included, add 2 teaspoons of anchovy sauce; if not, add 1 teaspoon.

6. Grease a pan, spread the batter thinly, and fry until golden brown.

#CheeseToast #Toast #Bread

-Ingredients

43g unsalted butter, 10g acacia honey, 4 slices of oat rye bread

120g mozzarella cheese

-Recipe

1. Melt the butter.

2. Mix 40g of unsalted butter and 10g of acacia honey. (You can add more honey. Adding 20g makes it sweeter and tastier.)

3. Spread butter on only one side of the bread.

4. Place the bread with the buttered side down.

5. Place 60g of mozzarella cheese on each side and cover with the other slice of bread.

(Bake with the buttered side facing outwards.)

6. Spread 3g of butter evenly in the empty spaces of the pan and bake.

7. Once the cheese has completely melted, it is done.

#PumpkinStew #RoundPumpkinStew #PumpkinStewWithSaltedShrimp

-Ingredients

1 round pumpkin, 1/2 onion (100g), 90g green onion, 3 Cheongyang peppers, 1 red pepper

1 tablespoon cooking oil, 1/2 tablespoon minced garlic, 400ml water, 1 packet anchovy powder broth

1/2 tablespoon salted shrimp, 1/2 tablespoon red pepper powder, 1/2 tablespoon perilla oil

-Recipe

1. Slice the round pumpkin, onion, green onion, and peppers.

2. Heat 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in a pan, add 1/2 tablespoon minced garlic and the onion, and sauté.

3. Once the onion becomes slightly translucent, add the pumpkin and sauté. 4. Pour in 400ml of water.

5. Add 1 packet of anchovy broth powder and half a spoonful of salted shrimp paste.

6. Close the lid and cook for 3 minutes.

7. Add chili peppers, green onions, and half a spoonful of red pepper powder, and boil for a total of 10 minutes.

8. Finally, turn off the heat and add half a spoonful of perilla oil.

en-US.title: Chives for 1,700 won?! Chive kimchi that's amazing even when made fresh!
en-US.description:
#ChiveKimchi #ChiveFreshKimchi #FreshKimchi

-Ingredients

520g chives, 4 tablespoons anchovy fish sauce, 2 tablespoons concentrated anchovy paste, 200g onion, 3 tablespoons plum extract, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, 1 teaspoon ginger syrup, 5 tablespoons red chili powder, 2 tablespoons sesame seeds

-Recipe

1. Add 4 tablespoons anchovy fish sauce, 2 tablespoons concentrated anchovy paste, 200g sliced ​​onion, 3 tablespoons plum extract, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, and 1 teaspoon ginger syrup to the prepared chives and mix well.

2. Sprinkle 5 tablespoons of red chili powder while mixing.

3. Finally, add 2 tablespoons of sesame seeds.

en-US.title: Only available now! "Fresh Onion Kimchi that is delicious even when eaten immediately and isn't s...
en-US.description:
#FreshOnionKimchi #OnionKimchi #SteelOnionKimchi

-Ingredients

2.5kg fresh onions, 3 liters water, 200ml sea salt, 3 tablespoons cooked rice, 200ml red chili powder

10 cloves garlic, 2 tablespoons salted shrimp paste, 4 tablespoons anchovy fish sauce, 4 tablespoons plum extract

2 yogurts, 1 teaspoon ginger syrup, 2 tablespoons concentrated anchovy paste

-Recipe

1. Peel the outer skin of the fresh onions and cut off only the roots. If there are any dirty leaves on top, cut them off.

2. Make two cross-shaped cuts in the onions.

3. Dissolve 200ml of sea salt in 3 liters of water.

4. Marinate the onions for 1 hour. (Please flip it over once in the middle.)

5. Add 3 tablespoons of cooked rice, 10 cloves of garlic, 2 tablespoons of salted shrimp paste, 4 tablespoons of anchovy fish sauce, 4 tablespoons of plum extract, 2 yogurts, 1 teaspoon of ginger syrup, and 2 tablespoons of concentrated anchovy paste, then blend.

6. Add 200ml of red chili powder.

7. Rinse the onions in water just once, drain them, and let them sit for 30 minutes.

8. Coat the onions evenly with the seasoning.

snippet.title: 🔴  쑥의계절 쑥향을 즐기는 떡 '쑥버무리' 뚝딱 생방송
snippet.description:
#쑥떡 #쑥버무리 #쑥
-재료
밤 20개, 병아리콩 50ml (20분 삶아주세요), 대추 50g, 쑥 180g
습식 찹쌀가루  200ml, 건식찹쌀가루 400ml,  자일로스 설탕 3스푼, 소금 2g, 물 100ml

-레시피
1. 밤을 썰어주세요.
2. 쑥을 손질해서 밀가루 1스푼 넣고 깨끗하게 씻어주세요.
3. 습식 찹쌀가루를 채반에 곱게 내려주세요.
4. 건식 찹쌀가루 400ml에 소금 2g, 자일로스 설탕 2스푼 넣고 섞어주세요.
5. 물 100ml를 건식 찹쌀가루에 넣고 섞어주세요.
6. 습식과 건식 찹쌀가루를 섞어서 채반에 곱게 한번 내려주세요.
7. 찜기에 면보하나 깔고 면보에 설탕 1스푼 골고루 뿌려주세요.
8. 쑥에 찹쌀가루를 골고루 묻혀주세요.
9. 찜기에 쑥을 넣고 밤, 대추, 병아리콩 등 골고루 뿌려서 담아주세요.
10. 젓가락으로 구멍을 여러개 내서 10분 쪄주세요.

en-US.title: 🔴 Mugwort Season: 'Ssukbeomuri' Rice Cakes to Enjoy the Scent of Mugwort - Quick and Easy Live Br...
en-US.description:
#MugwortRiceCake #MugwortRiceCake #Mugwort

-Ingredients

20 chestnuts, 50ml chickpeas (boil for 20 minutes), 50g jujubes, 180g mugwort

200ml wet glutinous rice flour, 400ml dry glutinous rice flour, 3 tablespoons xylitol sugar, 2g salt, 100ml water

-Recipe

1. Slice the chestnuts.

2. Prepare the mugwort, add 1 tablespoon of flour, and wash it thoroughly.

3. Sift the wet glutinous rice flour finely through a sieve.

4. Add 2g of salt and 2 tablespoons of xylitol sugar to 400ml of dry glutinous rice flour and mix.

5. Add 100ml of water to the dry glutinous rice flour and mix.

6. Mix the wet and dry glutinous rice flours together and sift them finely through a sieve once more. 7. Line a steamer with a cheesecloth and sprinkle 1 spoonful of sugar evenly over it.

8. Coat the mugwort evenly with glutinous rice flour.

9. Place the mugwort in the steamer and sprinkle chestnuts, dates, chickpeas, etc., evenly over it.

10. Poke several holes with chopsticks and steam for 10 minutes.

#SeasonedYoungGarlic #SeasonedYoungGarlicSeaweed #SeasonedSeaweed

-Ingredients

300g young garlic, 8 sheets of Gopchang Gim (dried laver), 2.5 liters of water, 1 tablespoon of sea salt

1 teaspoon of sugar, 1 teaspoon of plum extract, 1 teaspoon of dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of anchovy fish sauce

1 red chili pepper, 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds, 2 tablespoons of sesame oil

-Recipe

1. Wash the young garlic thoroughly, making sure to get between the leaves.

2. Slice the young garlic into pieces about 6cm apart.

3. If the young garlic is thick, cut it in half.

4. Add 1 tablespoon of sea salt to 1.5 liters of water, put in the stems first, and blanch for 40 seconds.

5. Add the leaves and blanch for another 20 seconds, then drain. 6. Roast the dried seaweed.

7. Put the crushed seaweed in a bag.

8. Mix together 1 teaspoon of sugar, 1 teaspoon of plum extract, 1 teaspoon of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of anchovy fish sauce, and 2 tablespoons of sesame oil.

9. Squeeze out the excess water from the green garlic and add it.

10. Finely chop 1 red chili pepper.

11. Do not mix the seaweed all at once; instead, add it in three batches while mixing.

12. Finally, add 1 tablespoon of whole sesame seeds.

#Bangpungnamul #BangpungnamulSeasoning #SpringNamulSeasoning

-Ingredients

400g Bangpungnamul, 1 tablespoon sea salt, 1 tablespoon cooking oil

2 teaspoons dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon soybean paste, 1 tablespoon plum extract, 1 tablespoon sesame oil

1 Cheongyang chili pepper, 2 tablespoons minced green onion (or leeks), 1 tablespoon sesame seeds

-Recipe

1. Wash and prepare the Bangpungnamul. Add 1 tablespoon of sea salt and 1 tablespoon of cooking oil to 2 liters of water, then blanch the stems first for 1 minute.

2. Rinse the Bangpungnamul in cold water.

3. Squeeze out the excess water from the Bangpungnamul and cut it into bite-sized pieces. 4. Add 2 teaspoons of dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of soybean paste, 1 tablespoon of plum extract, and 1 tablespoon of sesame oil to the *Bangpungnamul* and mix well.

5. Add 1 chopped Cheongyang chili pepper and 2 tablespoons of chopped green onion (or leeks) and mix well.

6. Finally, add 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds.

snippet.description:
#해물파전 #파전 #막걸리
-재료
당근 50g, 양파 반개, 청양고추 5개, 홍고추 1개, 오징어 1마리(400g)
새우 10마리, 탄산수 350ml, 부침가루 200ml, 튀김가루 200ml
청주 2스푼, 멸치액젓 반스푼, 쪽파 300g

-레시피
1. 당근, 양파 채를 썰어주세요.
2. 청양고추, 홍고추를 다져주세요.
3. 오징어를 먹기 좋은 크기로 썰어주세요.
4. 새우가 크면 조금 썰어주세요.
5. 부침가루 200ml, 튀김가루 200ml 섞어주세요.
6. 오징어, 새우에 섞은 청주 2스푼, 멸치액젓 반스푼, 반죽가루 2스푼만 넣어서 섞어주세요.
7. 반죽가루에 탄산수 350ml 섞어주세요.
8. 팬에 식용유를 두르고 쪽파를 반죽에 묻혀서 펼쳐주세요.
9. 당근, 양파채를 골고루 올리고 오징어, 새우도 올려주세요.
10. 고추를 골고루 올려서 구워주세요.

en-US.title: 🔴 The secret to keeping the seafood from falling out of 'Seafood Pajeon': Crispy! Golden Recipe -...
en-US.description:
#SeafoodPajeon #Pajeon #Makgeolli

-Ingredients

50g carrot, 1/2 onion, 5 Cheongyang peppers, 1 red pepper, 1 squid (400g)

10 shrimp, 350ml sparkling water, 200ml pancake mix, 200ml frying mix

2 tablespoons Cheongju, 1/2 tablespoon anchovy fish sauce, 300g chives

-Recipe

1. Julienne the carrot and onion.

2. Chop the Cheongyang peppers and red pepper.

3. Cut the squid into bite-sized pieces.

4. If the shrimp are large, cut them into smaller pieces.

5. Mix 200ml of pancake mix and 200ml of frying mix.

6. Add the mixed 2 tablespoons of Cheongju, 1/2 tablespoon of anchovy fish sauce, and 2 tablespoons of batter mix to the squid and shrimp, then mix well. 7. Mix 350ml of sparkling water into the batter mix.

8. Grease a pan with cooking oil, coat the chives in the batter, and spread them out.

9. Spread the shredded carrots and onions evenly, then add the squid and shrimp.

10. Sprinkle the chili peppers evenly and grill.

#반찬 #마늘쫑조림 #마늘쫑볶음 
-재료
마늘쫑 한단 ( 500g), 꽈리고추 100g, 마늘 10알
마늘쫑 1.5리터, 천일염 1스푼, 식용유 2스푼, 소금 1g
진간장 4스푼, 매실액 2스푼, 멸치액젓 1스푼, 물 4스푼, 조청 2스푼
청주 2스푼, 참기름 1스푼, 통깨 1스푼

-레시피
1. 마늘쫑을 봉우리는 잘라내고 5cm 간격으로 썰어주세요.
2. 꽈리고추는 포크로 찔러주세요.
3. 마늘을 편 썰어주세요.
4. 끓는 물 1.5리터에 천일염 1스푼 넣고 마늘쫑을 30초 데쳐주세요.
5. 마늘쫑을 건져주세요.
6. 팬에 식용유 2스푼 두르고 마늘을 볶아주세요.
7. 꽈리고추를 넣고 소금 1g 넣고 같이 볶아주세요.
8. 마늘쫑을 넣고 진간장 4스푼, 매실액 2스푼, 멸치액젓 1스푼, 물 4스푼, 청주 2스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
9. 조청 2스푼 넣고 졸여주세요.
10. 다 졸여지면 마지막에 참기름 1스푼, 통깨 1스푼 넣고 섞어주세요.

en-US.title: No more aged kimchi! Finish a whole container of 'Eolgari Napa Cabbage Kimchi' in no time for jus...
en-US.description:
#EolgariKimchi #EolgariNapaCabbageKimchi

-Ingredients

3kg Eolgari (5 bunches), 300ml sea salt, 200ml water, 1/2 onion, 1/2 pear, 1/2 apple

1/2 onion, 300g chives, 1 bowl of cooked barley (50ml barley rice), 80g garlic,

350ml kelp broth (10g kelp), 50g dried red chili peppers (soak for 10 minutes)

1/2 spoon ginger syrup, 3 spoons salted shrimp paste, 100ml anchovy sauce, 60ml plum extract, 200ml red chili powder

-Recipe

1. Cut the cleaned Eolgari in half and sprinkle 300ml of sea salt evenly over it to salt it.

2. Sprinkle 200ml of water evenly over it to salt it. 3. Put half an onion, half a pear, half an apple, 1 cup of cooked barley, 80g of garlic, 350ml of kelp broth, and 50g of soaked dried chili peppers into a blender and blend.

4. Slice half an onion and 300g of chives.

5. Add half a spoonful of ginger syrup, 3 spoonfuls of salted shrimp paste, 100ml of anchovy fish sauce, 60ml of plum extract, and 200ml of red chili powder to the blended seasoning.

6. Mix the onion and chives into the seasoning.

7. Rinse the Chinese cabbage, which has been marinated for 1 hour, once in water and drain.

8. Squeeze out the water and let it sit for 30 minutes.

9. Toss with the seasoning.

10. Eat immediately or let it ferment for half a day before eating.

#BraisedChicken #SoySauceChicken #GrilledSoySauceChicken

-Ingredients

1kg chicken, 2 pinches of salt, 3 tablespoons rice wine, black pepper, 200g potatoes

3 Cheongyang peppers, 1 red chili pepper, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 4 tablespoons dark soy sauce, 3 tablespoons mirin

5 tablespoons water, 1 teaspoon oyster sauce, 3 tablespoons corn syrup, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, 1 teaspoon ginger syrup

1 packet vegetable broth powder, 1 tablespoon sesame oil

-Recipe

1. Wash the chicken thoroughly with flour.

2. Season the chicken with 2 pinches of salt, 3 tablespoons of rice wine, and black pepper. 3. Slice the potatoes thickly and rinse them once in water.

4. Slice 3 Cheongyang peppers and 1 red pepper.

5. Mix together 1 tablespoon of brown sugar, 4 tablespoons of soy sauce, 3 tablespoons of mirin, 5 tablespoons of water, 1 teaspoon of oyster sauce, 3 tablespoons of corn syrup, 1 tablespoon of minced garlic, and 1 teaspoon of ginger syrup.

6. Lightly coat a pan with cooking oil, add the potatoes and chicken, cover with a lid, and let it sit for 5 minutes.

7. Remove the lid and let it sit for another 5 minutes.

8. Once all the liquid has evaporated, flip the chicken over. Remove the potatoes and set them aside.

9. Once they are golden brown, pour in the sauce.

10. Add the potatoes and peppers and mix well.

11. Add 1 packet of vegetable broth powder. (Optional)

12. Finally, add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil.

#PorkBulgogi #GochujangBulgogi #SpicySpicyPorkStirFry

-Ingredients
600g pork shoulder, 2 tablespoons gochujang, 1/3 onion, 1 green onion, 3 Cheongyang peppers

2 tablespoons cooking oil, 2 tablespoons minced garlic, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 2/3 tablespoon sugar, 3 tablespoons rice wine

1 teaspoon ginger syrup, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 3 tablespoons red chili powder, 2 tablespoons corn syrup, 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, black pepper

-Recipe

1. Slice the onion thinly.

2. Slice the green onion and Cheongyang peppers diagonally.

3. Wipe the blood off the pork shoulder. 4. Cut the pork shoulder into bite-sized pieces.

5. Heat 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in a pan and sauté 2 tablespoons of minced garlic.

6. Add the pork shoulder first, then add 2/3 tablespoon of sugar and stir-fry.

7. Add 3 tablespoons of rice wine and stir-fry.

8. Add 1 teaspoon of ginger syrup and stir-fry.

9. Add 3 tablespoons of soy sauce and stir-fry.

10. Add onion, green onion, and chili pepper and stir-fry.

11. Add 2 tablespoons of gochujang and 3 tablespoons of red chili powder and stir-fry.

12. Add 2 tablespoons of corn syrup and stir-fry.

13. Add 1 packet of vegetable broth powder. (Optional)

14. Add black pepper, 1 tablespoon of sesame seeds, and 1 tablespoon of sesame oil.

#어묵볶음 #오뎅볶음

-재료
구멍난 어묵 6개, 식용유 3스푼, 물엿 2스푼, 진간장 1스푼, 파슬리

1. 어묵을 끓는물에 1분 데쳐서 건져주세요.
2. 어묵을 길게 4등분으로 썰어주세요.

6. 물엿 2스푼 넣고 섞어주세요.
7. 진간장 1스푼 넣고 볶아주세요.
8. 마지막에 파슬리를 뿌려주세요.

en-US.title: The side dish is cute... but it's delicious... The transformation of fish cake: Stir-fried twiste...
en-US.description:
#FishcakeStir-Fry #OdengStir-Fry

- Ingredients
6 fish cakes with holes, 3 tablespoons cooking oil, 2 tablespoons corn syrup, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, parsley

- Recipe
1. Blanch the fish cakes in boiling water for 1 minute and drain.
2. Cut the fish cakes lengthwise into 4 pieces.
3. Tie the fish cakes together.
4. Heat 3 tablespoons cooking oil in a pan and stir-fry the fish cakes.
5. Once the fish cakes are golden brown, wipe off the excess oil.
6. Add 2 tablespoons corn syrup and mix.
7. Add 1 tablespoon soy sauce and stir-fry.
8. Sprinkle with parsley at the end.
